snippet.title: Aeternum Grand Plaza Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover the fascinating hotel Aeternum Grand Plaza, where you must pay attention to your surroundings and choose the right path to find the exit.

Aeternum Grand Plaza is an anomaly search game set in a hotel that has different scenarios and is inspired by “The Exit 8”. In this game the player must advance through the different floors of the hotel trying to reach the exit while paying attention to the details of the corridors through which he walks, trying to find strange elements that may indicate that this is not the correct corridor. The procedure is simple: if the corridor contains no anomalies, the player must continue forward to continue advancing through the floors. But if the corridor contains strange elements, you must turn around to continue advancing floors and try to reach the exit.
